comment: IDPico puts the scope claims (email, email_verified, name) and client_id in the ID token for the code flow so that relying parties that only read the ID token (Kubernetes, most proxies) get them; OIDC Core 5.4 says they belong in UserInfo. Deliberate; see CONFORMANCE.md.

IDPico has no given_name, family_name, picture, locale... - only name. Unsupported claims.
The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported=false), so name is only released for scope profile.
No authentication context classes; acr_values is ignored and no acr claim is returned (SHOULD).

current-block: Testing if access token was revoked after authorization code reuse (the AS 'should' have revoked the access token)
comment: Access tokens are stateless JWTs; code reuse revokes the refresh tokens of the grant but an already issued access token stays valid until it expires (SHOULD).
